palette.title: Brunr: Toggle
palette.about: Show or hide the Brunr panel

palette.title: Brunr: Keys
palette.about: Show Brunr and give it the keyboard, or hide it when it is shown (ctrl-shift-u). Up/Down move, Enter runs or folds, r runs a folder, e Environment, o opens a Request in the pane, Esc leaves

palette.title: Brunr: Reload
palette.about: Read brunr.json, the Bruno workspace, every Collection and the Bruno CLI check again
